instruction.text: Du willst im Text nach der Hauptstadt der Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate suchen. Wähle geeignete Schlüsselbegriffe.
Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff capital.
instruction.sound: Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff  <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>capital</voice>

atoms.b: Dubai is one of the most well known cities in the United Arab Emirates. That's why people often mistake Dubai as the ((capital)) city of UAE. Contrary to the popular belief, Dubai is not the ((capital)) of UAE, but Abu Dhabi is. Yet, the misunderstanding probably occurs, because Dubai is the most visited city in all of of UAE.

instruction.text: Wie heißt die Hauptstadt der VAE?

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Vereinigte Arabische Emirate ist die deutsche Übersetzung von</voice> United Arab Emirates.

instruction.text: Du willst herausfinden, wie warm es im Januar in Dubai ist. Wähle geeignete Schlüsselbegriffe.
Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff degrees celsius (°C).
instruction.sound: Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>degrees celsius</voice>

atoms.b: We went to Dubai in January during the winter holiday. Now, you might think that it was cold there, that I had to wear warm clothes and spend much time indoors. However, it was the exact opposite. While it snowed in Germany, we had lots of sunshine in Dubai. It was ((23°C)) during our whole stay, which is why we spent a lot of time outdoors exploring this wonderful city. You also need to know that the temperatures can rise to over ((40°C)) in the summer months. Consequently, I wouldn't quite recommend visiting Dubai in the summer holidays.

instruction.text: Wie warm ist es im Januar in Dubai?
Du willst herausfinden, wie lange der Flug von Berlin nach Dubai dauert. Wähle geeignete Schlüsselbegriffe.
Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff hour.
instruction.sound: Tippe im Text auf den Schlüsselbegriff <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>hour</voice>

atoms.b: We went to Dubai via plane. After a 6 ((hour)) long flight, we landed in Dubai at 4pm. Thankfully, we were not jetlagged after the flight, since there is no big time difference between Dubai and Berlin. Dubai is only 3 ((hours)) ahead of Berlin. As a result, we could start our holiday without any inconveniences.
